title: Split!
body:
🦙 Llama Style PvP Mod – PRESS G AND SPIT LIKE A BEAST!

Get ready to dominate the battlefield with the Llama Style PvP Mod! Inspired by the savage spirit of Minecraft’s angriest mobs, this mod lets you press G (default) to launch a deadly spit attack, just like a llama — but way cooler.

🔥 Features:
Custom "Spit Attack" ability – Triggered by pressing G, it fires a high-speed projectile straight at your enemy's face.

Spit deals knockback and solid damage — use it to interrupt fights, flex in duels, or finish off your opponents with style.

Cooldown system – No spamming! Stay tactical.

Works in multiplayer – Humiliate your enemies in front of their squad 😈


🧠 Bonus:
Inspired by real llamas. But this ain’t your grandma’s petting zoo.

Great for PvP servers, roleplay, or chaotic modpacks.
